rationale: Reallocates recurrent-tail fp16 export budget from broadly keeping Q/K toward keeping V on both tail blocks, while also making quant-aware blending slightly stronger on value-path tensors. The hypothesis is that the exact int8+zlib score is more sensitive to late-tail value/projection corruption than to an extra tail K matrix, so this should improve final roundtrip quality without a sprawling rewrite.
title: Tail Value-Path Float Reallocation
